claims.text: The Hugging Face card identifies UI-Mate-27B as a 27B Apache-2.0 foundation GUI agent fine-tuned from Qwen3.6-27B, emitting pyautogui-compatible actions from screenshots.
The card lists OSWorld-Verified 77.0, WindowsAgentArena 66.2, OSWorkerBench 41.00 strict/76.86 progress.
